messages:
jordan (People Ops): Following up from today's all-hands 94Hybrid & travel Qs94 94starting a single thread for anything we didn't get to. I'll update with links and an FAQ after.

sam (Eng): Quick: our team has two cross-functional days/month we prefer to be in person. Is that okay or do we need to align with the 2 days/week guidance?

jordan (People Ops): Good callout. The "2 days/week" is guidance for general sync and culture; teams can set alternatives that work (e.g., intensive monthly collabs) as long as managers document expectations in the team charter.

alex (Design): For offsite RSVP logistics 94 will Redwood cover travel to + from airport if people choose different return dates?

nina (People Ops): Reimbursements only cover the company-approved travel window. If you extend personal days, you cover the extra nights. If a different return date is cheaper or required, tag Finance and People Ops on the travel request for pre-approval.

office-bot: Badge & visitor reminder: vendors/guests require sponsor approval 72 hours before arrival. See: https://redwood.company/visitor-access

sophia (CEO): On inclusivity: we recognize travel impacts caretakers. We will reimburse emergency childcare expenses for required company travel; we're piloting a childcare stipend for the fall offsite and will share details soon.

sam (Eng): Any support for visa/long-distance international staff when HQ events are mandated?

nina (People Ops): For required travel that needs visas we provide documentation letters and will coordinate with Legal. Reach out to People Ops early (ideally 6+ weeks) for visa support and booking.

jordan (People Ops): Desk booking update: hot-desking remains primary. If your team needs recurring desks for a week-long team sprint, submit a hoteling request and we'll allocate a block (max 10 business days).

alex (Design): How do we get access to the offsite repo/materials?

jordan (People Ops): We'll spin up a public-internal repo redwood-offsites/2026-fall and share access when RSVPs close.

sophia (CEO): Leadership ask: team leads, please confirm on-site core days or alternate cadence by next Fri so we can map space and staffing.

sam (Eng): Thanks. One more: will travel training still be required to use the company card?

nina (People Ops): Yes 94 complete the 12-min travel module in Workday to be enabled for company bookings.

jordan (People Ops): I'll post a short FAQ with links to the badge portal, expense codes (OFFSITE-2026), per diem caps, and the booking guide by EOD. Ping me or Nina for 1:1s.

alex (Design): Happy to volunteer for on-site setup 94 DMing you now.

sophia (CEO): Appreciate the volunteers. We'll make sure schedules and childcare options are considered when finalizing dates.

jordan (People Ops): Thanks all 94 closing thread soon but keep Qs coming here and I'll append answers. :raised_hands:
